nodes.title: axe-core 4.10.2, WCAG 2.0/2.1 A+AA, on 24 main screen states of the seeded workspace at 1440 and 390 px: before 24 serious (one rule, color-contrast on the sidebar member line), after 0 critical/serious/moderate/minor in light and dark (96 states); keyboard-only completion of create agent, test call, CSV import, publish and launch cap passes; 0 of 24 screens scroll sideways at 320 px.
nodes.method: product/web/e2e/a11y.mjs (Playwright Chromium, reducedMotion reduce); gate flow in web/e2e/flows.test.mjs fails on any serious or critical violation; table in research/2026-10-24/walkthrough/A11Y.md.
nodes.not_verified: A screen reader by ear; 200% desktop zoom; sign-up/login, a real-model Operator chat, a live campaign and Insights with proposals.

nodes.title: Accessibility is a gate: the browser flows run axe on every main screen at desktop and phone width and fail on any serious or critical violation; dimmed text uses a checked token pair, never opacity.
nodes.rationale: Enterprise buyers ask for WCAG 2.1 AA; opacity hid a contrast failure from every tool.
nodes.reverse_if: The gate adds more than a minute to CI and a cheaper equivalent exists.

nodes.title: Dimming text with opacity (the sidebar member line).
nodes.tried: style={{ opacity: 0.8 }} on nav text over --forest-2.
nodes.broke: axe could not resolve the pair and flagged it serious on every desktop screen; a person's contrast checker cannot see through opacity either. Replaced by --nav-ink-dim (5.09:1 light, 6.95:1 dark), added to the token-contrast test.

nodes.title: A dialog focus effect keyed on its onClose prop.
nodes.tried: Sheet useEffect(..., [onClose]) with callers passing inline functions.
nodes.broke: Any parent re-render while a sheet was open re-ran the effect and threw focus to the sheet's first control (latent: no current flow re-rendered mid-typing). The effect now runs once per opening and reads onClose from a ref.

nodes.title: The browser-call flow writing product/web/shots/browser-call-live.png on every run.
nodes.broke: Every `node scripts/test.mjs` left the tree dirty. The shot now goes to E2E_DIAG_DIR unless E2E_RESHOOT=1, and web.test.ts fails if the flows change any tracked file under product/web.

nodes.title: server/app.ts serves every static file with cache-control immutable for a year and without Range: the samples manifest and clips work around it (a fresh query on the manifest, ?v=<recordedAt> on each clip). The web commit added audio/ogg for .ogg/.opus to the MIME map, because the voice renderer writes Ogg/Opus.
nodes.closes_when: server/app.ts:158 sends no-cache for /samples/manifest.json and Range for audio, or a decision says the workaround stands.

events.title: Web: tests leave the tree clean; axe WCAG 2.1 AA gate (0 serious/critical, light and dark, 1440/390); skip link; sheet focus fix; reduced-motion scrolls; stack voice samples from /samples/manifest.json (ships empty)
